intervention: MC1568, sold as a class IIa-selective inhibitor, for 7 days from 24 h after MCAO

effect_note: MBP density lower than vehicle together with MAP2 and pNFH and with higher mortality and lesion volume; authors suggest myelin loss is secondary to neuronal death; oligodendrocyte death not assessed (TUNEL too late)
